inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL multi-table UPDATE joins a target table through a link table and a classification table, then changes only target rows whose joined classification matches a predicate.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one target that matches the policy and one target linked to a different policy; the joined UPDATE changes only the matching lifecycle.

fixture_notes: Item 4201 changes from listed to retired through policy 31; item 4202 links to hold policy 32 and remains listed.
determinism_notes: All IDs and final reads are fixed and ordered. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_items_min (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, lifecycle VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE item_policy_links_min (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, policy_id INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE lifecycle_policies_min (policy_id INT PRIMARY KEY, policy_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, target_lifecycle VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE catalog_items_min AS i JOIN item_policy_links_min AS l ON l.item_id = i.item_id JOIN lifecycle_policies_min AS p ON p.policy_id = l.policy_id SET i.lifecycle = p.target_lifecycle WHERE p.policy_name = 'retire'

checks.sql: SELECT item_id, lifecycle FROM catalog_items_min ORDER BY item_id
SELECT item_id, policy_id FROM item_policy_links_min ORDER BY item_id
